newsitem.title: USA: Fed broadens CoreStates underwriting power.
newsitem.headline: Fed broadens CoreStates underwriting power.

text.p: The Federal Reserve announced on Monday that it approved a proposal by CoreStates Financial Corp of Philadelphia to engage, through a subsidiary, in underwriting some securities.

CoreStates will be able to underwrite and deal in certain municipal revenue bonds as well as family mortgage-related securities, consumer receivable-related securities and commercial paper, the Fed said.
CoreStates has total assets of $45.3 billion and is the 21st largest bank in the United States.
